about.title: About us
about.lead: Fawal Trading has supplied steel wire, metal mesh and bar across Syria for more than fifty years.
about.body: The company was established in 2001 under its parent, Mohammad Ibrahim Fawal Trading, and has worked since then to be among the first in its field by guaranteeing the quality of its products and building solutions around each customer. To focus more closely on the different types of steel and wire products, affiliated companies were founded under joint sponsorship to cover the rest of the industrial market's needs.
about.principle1Body: Our aim is a satisfied customer and a relationship built on trust and continuity, so we believe in saying only what is true.
about.principle2Body: We help you understand what your work genuinely needs and what it does not, then find the solution that serves your case specifically.
about.principle3Body: High quality at fair prices, and commitment, so we are the closest to you and a partner in every success.
about.networkBody: Fawal Trading's own plant is in Douma, Damascus countryside. Together with the companies founded under joint sponsorship, the group operates three plants across Syria and Jordan. The company runs on family management, on-time delivery and careful planning, which is what carried it through the economic crises and kept it competitive.
